gloss: Switch between lenses while carrying forward what each earlier lens showed
mechanism: When work moves through several lenses, such as history, structure, possibility and feeling, each switch is a {{reframe}} that records what the previous lens showed before the next is applied. The final account cites what each lens contributed, and none is dropped without a stated reason.
invariants: Each switch records what the previous lens showed.
The final account cites each lens's contribution or states why it was dropped.
failure_modes: Last-lens bias: only the final lens shapes the account.
Lens tourism: lenses are visited without anything being carried forward.
